notes: S3-FIX1 (decision 2026-11-17 #5), review A medium-3 R1b: two agent notes of the same origin carry the same actor.idempotency_key; the second one is by agent-2, whom the grant does not name (E_GRANT_GRANTEE_MISMATCH). The pair is decided by the origin and the idempotency key alone, not by actor.key, so the container reports N_IDEMPOTENCY_DUPLICATE (§5.4). The Python verifier also compared actor.key before the fix.
